title: PanPhyloFlow parameters
description: Machine-readable parameter contract for PanPhyloFlow. Runtime checks in main.nf remain authoritative until schema validation is integrated into the workflow entry point.

input.description: CSV samplesheet. FASTA mode requires sample,genome; GFF mode requires sample,gff.

pangenome.description: Pangenome inference engine. The publication release should revisit whether this choice remains a silent default.

core_threshold.description: Genome prevalence fraction used to classify a gene family as core; not a clustering identity threshold.

panaroo_family_threshold.description: Panaroo family threshold; not equivalent to Roary -i.
